body: This amazing, beautiful, and sensitive Australian documentary shows fascinating dynamics playing out among some Amish folk … The ending brought back memories for me, as we have a son who is a cancer survivor, and he was diagnosed with leukemia at about the same age as the beautiful little Amish girl Marie.
